The referral has been entered into our scheduling system and a team member will reach out to the patient today or the next business day.  

For your records, the patient ID is PRE1048965.  Please use this for all future communications.


We will also send them a text shortly letting them know to call us in case we miss them when we reach out.


The patient is welcome to call our direct scheduling line M-F 8am to 5pm @ 818-629-1169


Once we can schedule them and they complete their exam, reports are typically sent out within 24-72 hours.

Patients can also view their appointment times, answer prescreening questions and sign all liens here:
https://precise.radflow360.com/patient-portal
 
If this is also a personal injury case:
 
  • A report containing the findings of the exam will also be sent to the attorney
  • A bill will be sent to the attorney once both the patient and the attorney sign all pending liens
  • Please make sure to submit a negotiation offer before sending the payment
 
 
Access bills, appointment times, and e-sign liens​  (Click request login if you don't have an account)

Access reports & images  (Request login here for reports)

On Tue, Jan 28, 2025 at 1:39 PM Sandra Dentice <sdentice@victorylawllp.com> wrote:
Good afternoon,

Hope this helps regarding the referral and requested code. Please see below, thank you.


kevin kelly

1:37 PM (0 minutes ago)
to Mayra, me, Sara, Erik
Good Afternoon:

A CT scan that is requested is not a diagnosis, it is a procedure, therefore, no DX code is required for my referral.

I believe the ICD 10 billing code for CT of the Cervical Spine is BR20ZZZ. 

I do not bill for CT exams since I do not perform them, therefore, I do not put the ICD codes on my referral forms. If you are billing for this procedure, you might want to check with the MRI / CT facility to find out which code they use for a more accurate description.

My reason for the CT scan is to rule out cervical spine HNP ( Herniated Nucleus Pulposus). The code used for billing purposes to rule out a C spine HNP is M50.90. Again, since I am not billing for this procedure, merely requesting it, I do not include the code on my referrals. 

Hope that helps.

Dr. Kelly
